criteria.text: User Action: Clicks "Add chore" on the Chore List. Expected System Behavior: The "Add chore" screen opens with the household name above the title and four fields: Chore name, Assigned to, Due date, Notes (optional).
User Action: Clicks "Assigned to." Expected System Behavior: A dropdown lists all housemates in the household.
User Action: Clicks "Due date." Expected System Behavior: A date picker opens.
User Action: Fills in the required fields and clicks "Add chore." Expected System Behavior: The chore is saved, the Chore List opens, and the new chore appears in the list for all housemates.
User Action: Clicks "Cancel." Expected System Behavior: Returns to the Chore List without saving.
Error Condition: Chore name is empty. Message: "Chore name is required."
criteria.note: Corrected to the app's wording (team decision). Jira still says "Enter a chore name."

criteria.text: Error Condition: No housemate selected. Message: "Choose who this chore is assigned to."
